title: Hybrid seat + consumption enterprise pricing with per-route entitlements and streaming session billing
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD for a hybrid enterprise offering combining seat-based subscriptions + consumption billing. Adds per-route entitlements (route-level quotas and rate limits), a streaming-session meter with separate unit economics, clear proration behavior on plan change, invoice line-item requirements, and reconciliation flows for Dedicated/Private deployments. Goal: enable enterprise customers to buy predictable seat coverage while paying marginally for burst/overage usage and streaming sessions, with transparent billing and SLO-aware soft-fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: System must produce invoice line items for: seat charges (monthly recurring), consumption (token-based) aggregated by route, streaming sessions (session-count or minutes). Line items must include product code, usage window, unit price, units, and subtotal.

AC2: Per-route entitlements implemented as configurable quotas in the console and API. When route quota is exhausted, enforce soft-block with configurable grace policy (soft-throttle -> warning -> hard-block) and emit billing events for overage. Document behavior in console and API docs.

AC3: Streaming sessions are metered separately. A session meter emits start/stop events and calculates billed minutes with 1-minute rounding down and 15-second rounding up rules. Tests for accuracy within 2% for 1000 simulated sessions.

AC4: Seat proration: mid-cycle seat increases produce immediate pro-rated charge for remaining days; seat decreases schedule at end of billing window unless manual immediate credit approved by finance. Unit-tests and billing simulator must match finance proration table.

AC5: Dedicated/Private customers: usage telemetry exported to customer S3 or signed CSV if requested. Billing data must include region, pool-id, and model-version to support cost allocation. Implement export in v1 for Dedicated and Private with toggle in Console.

AC6: Rate limits enforced per-plan: per-second concurrency caps and token/sec rate caps per route. Enforcement must be reflected in API error codes (429 with structured metadata explaining limit type, reset window, and quota name) and UI quota panels.

AC7: Reconciliation: charges in billing system must reconcile to usage telemetry within 0.5% for monthly aggregated token counts for sample enterprise tenants (test fixtures). Discrepancies above threshold trigger an ops ticket with automatic draft invoice hold.

AC8: Customer-facing UX: Console must show remaining quota per route, projected spend pacing for month-to-date, and a one-click plan upgrade flow that shows estimated proration and forecasted monthly spend.

AC9: Security & compliance: no plaintext PII shipped in billing exports. Billing exports must respect data residency settings for Private deployments. Security review sign-off required before release.
AC10: E2E tests: automated tests validating invoicing, proration, rate-limit error metadata, quota transitions, and export generation must pass in CI and be included in release acceptance checklist.
